avoid_supplements.name: Psyllium husk
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Concurrent use of multiple bulk-forming and stimulant laxatives increases risk of intestinal obstruction, severe cramping, and dehydration
avoid_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2 hours; counsel patient on appropriate laxative selection

avoid_supplements.name: Senna
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive stimulant laxative effects may cause excessive bowel stimulation, electrolyte depletion, and intestinal dysfunction
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; alternate laxative agents or space dosing with clinical supervision

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: High-dose bisacodyl may transiently reduce beneficial bacterial colonization; probiotics may help maintain gut flora
caution_supplements.action: Administer probiotics at different times from bisacodyl; monitor for gastrointestinal tolerance

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals
avoid_foods.mechanism: Delays gastric emptying and may reduce bisacodyl efficacy; increases cramping and GI distress when laxative effect occurs
avoid_foods.action: Take bisacodyl on empty stomach; advise patient to avoid fatty foods within 2 hours of dose

caution_foods.name: Dairy products
caution_foods.mechanism: May coat GI mucosa and slightly delay tablet dissolution; minimal clinical impact
caution_foods.action: Space dairy consumption 1-2 hours from bisacodyl administration if decreased efficacy observed

caution_foods.name: High-fiber foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive laxative effect may increase GI cramping and urgency; can support overall bowel regularity
caution_foods.action: Moderate fiber intake when initiating bisacodyl; encourage adequate hydration throughout treatment

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of electrolyte depletion (weakness, muscle cramps), dehydration, and medication dependence with chronic use. Counsel patients that bisacodyl should not be used regularly for >1 week without medical supervision due to risk of laxative dependency and altered bowel function.
